name: Jausenstation Prastmann
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Jausenstation Prastmann in Tirol**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality at **Jausenstation Prastmann**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Whether you're hiking through the stunning **Zillertal** or exploring the charming streets of **Innsbruck**, this cozy mountain stop offers a warm retreat.

Savor traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and fresh **Käsebrezel**—all made with local ingredients. Pair your meal with a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a steaming cup of **Kaffee mit Schlag**.

Open year-round, **Prastmann** is the perfect place to refuel, relax, and soak in the breathtaking Alpine scenery. Just a short drive from **Mayrhofen** and **Erdmann** in the **Zillertal**, it’s an ideal stop for adventurers and food lovers alike.

Come for the food, stay for the memories—**Jausenstation Prastmann** awaits!
